headline: Camurus Q3 Revenue Beats Expectations
summary: Camurus reported third-quarter revenue that exceeded market expectations, driven by strong performance of its Buvidal product.
why: Camurus is a pharmaceutical company. Revenue beats are key drivers for biotech stock valuations, especially when driven by core product growth.

impacts.name: Camurus
impacts.why: Revenue beats typically lead to positive price action.
